verdict.rationale: Activepieces documents an embedding SDK that lets you embed and customize the builder in your SaaS and automatically provision users. Its pricing page explicitly offers the flow builder, agents and integrations 'inside your own product, under your own brand', and embeddable MCP extends this to embedded users. Missing for 10: detailed white-label branding docs (theming, custom domain, removing vendor branding), independent or hands-on corroboration of the embedding experience.

support.subject: As a developer, I can embed the automation platform white-label inside my own product for my customers

citations.quote: You can use the SDK to embed and customize Activepieces in your SaaS
